description: A recorded simulated run of the live demo: normal operation, Stop B, local failover, the controller confirms, Start B, hold-down, back to B. Events are the WebSocket messages in order, as sent. Apply demo-run.snapshot-initial.json first, then the events; or start from demo-run.snapshot-mid.json and discard events with event_id <= its last_event_id.

data.basis: fresh neighbor reports list it as lost (no HELLO heard)
